title: Basma YouTube Downloader Ultra Pro (.NET 8 / WPF / WinUI 3)
target_os: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (x64 Native Executable / Single-File Self-Contained .exe)
overview: A high-performance Windows desktop media downloader workstation built with .NET 8.0 / .NET 9.0, C# 12, WPF / WinUI 3 (Wpf.Ui Fluent Design), YoutubeExplode / YoutubeDLSharp (yt-dlp wrapper), and embedded FFmpeg stream multiplexing. Enables users to download single videos, entire playlists, and channels in 4K/8K 60FPS video or high-bitrate MP3/FLAC audio, featuring automated thumbnail & metadata tagging, incremental archive tracking (downloaded_archive.txt), multi-threaded batch queues, and sub-millisecond download speedometers without UI thread freezing.
key_features: Multi-Format & High-Resolution Quality Matrix: Stream analysis allowing selection of 4K/8K 60FPS video (AV1, VP9, H.264), high-bitrate MP3/AAC/FLAC audio extraction, and dynamic video/audio multiplexing via FFmpeg
Playlist & Channel Processing Engine: Full playlist link parsing with video range filtering, item selection checkmarks, and sequential or concurrent multi-item downloading queues
Incremental Download Archive & Duplicate Protection: Persistent downloaded_archive.txt database tracking video IDs to prevent redundant re-downloads across recurring playlist updates
Automated Metadata, Subtitles & Cover Art Tagging: Injects ID3/MP4 metadata tags, embeds high-resolution video thumbnail artwork, and downloads closed caption subtitle files (.vtt/.srt)

Non-Blocking Asynchronous Download Speedometer & ETA: Real-time calculation of download throughput (MB/s), byte percentage meters, active worker threads, and dynamic ETA estimation using System.Threading.Channels

Single-File Packaging & Auto-Binary Discovery: MSBuild single-file publish specification embedding static FFmpeg and yt-dlp binaries with dynamic runtime resolution across sys._MEIPASS and local bin folders

core_stack.gui_framework: WPF / WinUI 3 with Wpf.Ui (Fluent Dark Theme / Windows 11 Mica Glass Effects)
core_stack.downloader_and_ffmpeg: YoutubeExplode (v6.3+) / YoutubeDLSharp (v1.5+ wrapping yt-dlp.exe), FFMpegCore / static FFmpeg binaries
core_stack.packaging: MSBuild / dotnet publish (PublishSingleFile=true, SelfContained=true, IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true producing standalone ~55MB .exe)

design_system_and_theme.theme_name: Electric Crimson & Dark Velvet (Windows 11 Mica / Fluent Grid)

typography.font_family: Segoe UI Variable Display, Cascadia Code, Inter, sans-serif

system_architecture.pattern: Model-View-ViewModel (MVVM) with Async Multi-Threaded Download Pipeline
system_architecture.ui_layer: WPF / WinUI 3 XAML markup with Wpf.Ui Fluent dark controls, media item card queue, quality selector dropdowns, live speedometers, and embedded diagnostic console log
system_architecture.background_services: Asynchronous Task.Run download workers executing YoutubeExplode or YoutubeDLSharp process calls, FFmpeg stream multiplexers, and archive tracking file writers
system_architecture.ipc_and_event_bus: System.Threading.Channels (Channel) streaming atomic byte progress, speed metrics, and completion notifications directly to ViewModel
system_architecture.process_safety: Memory-safe managed C# 12 buffer pipelines, safe process group cancellation (CancellationTokenSource), and strict file handle closing to eliminate Windows file locking conflicts

ai_agent_prompt:
You are an elite Senior Desktop Systems & Media Software Engineer tasked with implementing a production-grade native C# / .NET 8 desktop application titled 'Basma YouTube Downloader Ultra Pro'.

### PROJECT OBJECTIVE:
Construct a zero-dependency, high-speed YouTube and web media downloader workstation using .NET 8.0 / .NET 9.0, C# 12, WPF / WinUI 3 (Wpf.Ui Fluent Design), YoutubeExplode / YoutubeDLSharp (yt-dlp wrapper), and embedded FFmpeg stream multiplexing. Enables users to download single videos, playlists, or channels in 4K/8K video or MP3/FLAC audio, featuring thumbnail & metadata embedding, incremental archive tracking (downloaded_archive.txt), and real-time MB/s speedometers without freezing the desktop UI.

### MANDATORY TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:
1. .NET 8.0 ARCHITECTURE & MVVM PATTERN:
   - Built with C# 12 and .NET 8.0 LTS using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm ([ObservableProperty], [RelayCommand]).
   - Styled using Wpf.Ui applying Fluent Dark theme tokens (#0A0B0E dark background, #E11D48 electric crimson primary accent, #F59E0B amber secondary accent) with Windows 11 Mica glass visual effects.

2. MEDIA DOWNLOAD ENGINE & FFMPEG MULTIPLEXING:
   - Integrate YoutubeExplode (or YoutubeDLSharp wrapping yt-dlp.exe) to parse media metadata (title, duration, codecs, available streams, thumbnails).
   - Combine separate high-resolution video streams (e.g. 4K AV1/VP9) and high-quality audio streams using dynamic FFMpegCore or FFmpeg process calls.

3. PLAYLIST FILTERING, ARCHIVE TRACKING & METADATA:
   - Support full YouTube playlist parsing with video selection checkboxes and range filters.
   - Implement incremental archive tracking using downloaded_archive.txt to automatically skip previously downloaded videos.
   - Automatically embed ID3/MP4 metadata tags, high-res thumbnail cover art, and download closed caption subtitles (.vtt/.srt).

4. REAL-TIME TELEMETRY & PROGRESS STREAMING:
   - Pass atomic byte transfer events, throughput speed calculations (MB/s), ETA estimation, and activity logs to the UI using System.Threading.Channels and IProgress<DownloadReport> without locking the main UI thread.

5. SINGLE-FILE PACKAGING & BINARY RESOLUTION:
   - Deliver complete C# source files (MainWindow.xaml, MainWindow.xaml.cs, MainViewModel.cs, YouTubeDownloaderService.cs, FFmpegService.cs) and a ready-to-publish .csproj configured for PublishSingleFile=true self-contained .exe output automatically bundling required native FFmpeg and yt-dlp binaries.
